<parameter=content>
Remind me what animal is typically regarded as man's best friend. OmniFit has introduced a subscription model for their fitness equipment, offering consumers the ability to upgrade to the latest models for a monthly fee. This strategy could change how fitness equipment is consumed, placing pressure on us to consider similar innovative pricing strategies to retain customer loyalty and stay relevant in the market.
